eventDetail.scope: The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Resilience and Endogenous Saftey & Security (IEEE CRESS 2026) aims to bring together researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to discuss the latest advancements, challenges, and emerging trends in cyber resilience and endogenous saftey & security. As cyber threats become more sophisticated and pervasive,ensurin g the security, integrity, and resilience of digital systems has become a critical priority for governments, businesses, and academia. This conference provides a platform for exchanging cutting-edge research and practical solutions in areas such as cyber defense strategies, secure system design, threat intelligence, cryptographic innovations, and AI-driven security solutions. It seeks to explore novel methodologies that enhance the robustness of networks, critical infrastructures, and digital services against cyberattacks and disruptions.
